_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Kil (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), BUILDOUT O5 batch 1 (2026-10-29). Drafted from OSM only so far; facts from the operator's station page, photos or a walk go here with their source. Level names are placeholders until a plan or signage names them.

sources.note: Laserdata Nedladdning, skog, © Lantmäteriet, bearbetad, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/740000206).
JNB 2027 Bilaga 2A and BanInfo Plattform: platform height classes (3D research pass; data/stations/research/trafikverket_platforms_SE.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (BUILDOUT O5 batch 1).
Platform heights from Trafikverket's register; 7 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/740000206).

1._source: Trafikverket register (CC0), Bilaga 2A tab 4 row 413; BanInfo BIS 455 (track ?): tracks 1, class låg = 0.35 m above rail, 108 m long; a recorded design class, not a survey

2 & 3._source: Trafikverket register (CC0), Bilaga 2A tab 4 row 414; BanInfo BIS 454 (track 2): tracks 3,2, class mellan = 0.58 m above rail, 197 m long; a recorded design class, not a survey

4 & 5._source: Trafikverket register (CC0), Bilaga 2A tab 4 row 412; BanInfo BIS 456 (track 4): tracks 4,5, class mellan = 0.58 m above rail, 218 m long; a recorded design class, not a survey

6 & 7._source: Trafikverket register (CC0), Bilaga 2A tab 4 row 415; BanInfo BIS 457 (track 6): tracks 6,7, class låg = 0.35 m above rail, 121 m long; a recorded design class, not a survey
